intended_object: The class formation (G_{K_w}, (K_w^sep)^×) at a real infinite place w of a field K, as in Artin–Tate Ch. XIV and Milne VIII §4. Here G_{K_w} has order 2, and the invariant map is the archimedean Brauer invariant, sending the nontrivial class of Br(ℝ) to 1/2. This is inferred from the docstring, the module documentation and the name.
